result.stdout:
Usage: precept-dashboard [options]

Shows local Precept runs on http://127.0.0.1, live and kept. It finds the runs of the projects on its list.

Options:
  --port <n>      Listen on this port instead of a free one.
  --no-browser    Do not open the page in a browser.
  --version       Print the version and exit.
  -h, --help      Print this help and exit.
